observations: Retrospective single-center cohort of pancreaticoduodenectomy for nonmalignant conditions (1995–2013); median follow-up 7.4 years. PMID:25442378.

entities.name: SNR predicts poorer survival
observations: In geriatric patients undergoing pancreaticoduodenectomy for benign disease, severe nutritional risk was associated with significantly worse long-term survival (p<0.001); five-year mortality was about 1/3 with risk versus 1/14 without. Adjusted effect size was unavailable; PMID:25442378.
